}}'''Sabeine Ocalin''' is one of the [[Kin]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Sabeine Ocalin}}

==Strength==
She is able to [[Travel]] alone, so she is above the level {{opsl|28}}, which would make her as strong as many Sitters.

== Activities ==
Due to ability to [[Travel]], she is sent to report on what the [[Borderlands]] army is doing. She is then told to watch and report on any movement the neutral [[High Seat]]s armies may make.
